biography.plain_text: Theodorus de Bruin, known as Theo, is a Dutch businessman and major shareholder of Warmteservice, the heating and installation supplies chain founded by his father. He joined its Amsterdam shop at seventeen and helped develop a national network. His sister Berry and childhood friend Frank Hoedemaker also served on the management team.

long_biography.plain_text:
At Warmteservice, Theo de Bruin's business brought trade supplies closer to installers through smaller branches. These compact outlets used less floor space and smaller teams while retaining a broad product range. Nearby full-sized branches handled their deliveries, allowing the company to serve gaps between existing stores without reproducing every function at each location.

De Bruin also worked on the systems behind the counter. As the organisation grew, boxes of monthly paperwork gave way to automated accounting and digital annual statements. He identified further automation as a way to improve oversight and planned to develop it with advisers from de Jong & Laan.
